findings.title: NPE fix is not applied to other cached subgroup accessors
findings.body: In GroupAdapter, the PR only null-checks the delegate loaded by modelSupplier in getSubGroupsCount(). The subgroup paging/search methods still dereference the supplier result directly: line 256 (getSubGroupsStream(String, Integer, Integer)), line 262 (getSubGroupsStream(Integer, Integer)), and line 268 (getSubGroupsStream(String, Boolean, Integer, Integer)). If the group is deleted concurrently, modelSupplier.get() can return null, so these methods can still throw the NullPointerException the PR is intended to fix.

findings.title: Concurrency test is racy and may pass without exercising the race
findings.body: The new concurrency test starts a reader thread but does not coordinate shutdown before asserting. deletedAll can be set before the reader performs any request, so the test may pass without exercising the race; exceptions appended by the reader after assertThat(caughtExceptions, ...) are missed; and if a group deletion throws before deletedAll.set(true), the reader loop never stops. The test should ensure the reader has started, stop it in a finally block, join it with a timeout, and then assert.
